description: Defines the interface and utility functions for the GraphExecutor implementation in Torch JIT runtime, including graph preparation, execution, and optimization controls.

classes.name: GraphExecutorImplBase
classes.description: Base class for executing and managing JIT graphs, including graph preparation, execution, and optimization status.

methods.name: prepareGraph
methods.description: Creates a copy of the graph and erases shape information for execution.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Begins execution of the graph with a given stack.

methods.name: runAsync
methods.description: Runs the graph asynchronously with a task launcher.

methods.name: getPlanFor
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the execution plan for a given stack.

methods.name: getDebugState
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the current debug state of the executor.

methods.name: isOptimized
methods.description: Indicates whether the graph has been optimized.
